scenes.description: A colorful pinwheel spins on a fixed stick, with blurred blade edges and small circular motion trails.
One hand winds a soft pink ribbon in several loose coils around a finger of the other hand.
Three panels show the same tabby cat in one place: alert, tilting its head curiously, then relaxed with closed eyes.
A side portrait shows rounded ringlet curls, with individual coils clearly outlined against a plain background.
